scripts.app:build:ios:sim: cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.app:build:ios:archive:unsigned: cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath build/CertezaHabitacional.xcarchive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO MARKETING_VERSION=1.0.0 CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=1 archive
scripts.app:assets:ios: mkdir -p .mobile-assets && cp public/branding/logo-badge.png .mobile-assets/logo.png && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --assetPath .mobile-assets --iconBackgroundColor '#0f172a' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0f172a' --splashBackgroundColor '#0f172a' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0f172a'
scripts.app:assets:android: mkdir -p .mobile-assets && cp public/branding/logo-badge.png .mobile-assets/logo.png && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --assetPath .mobile-assets --iconBackgroundColor '#0f172a' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0f172a' --splashBackgroundColor '#0f172a' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0f172a'
